add.title: V1 used to hide the owner's own bubble whenever the fast seat turned a sentence into a Question
add.why: Widget.Thread.show_task() set parent.style.display='none' whenever t.question was true (Widget.js, Chat V1 drawing), swallowing the raw sentence behind the Question card; a place/improve edit separately overwrote the raw text with the cleaned text (patch_piece(..., {text})). Confirmed on a real session, public/framework/ai/sessions/2026/11/01/v-u48msei/session.jsonl lines 3, 4, 10, 12. The writer (the fast seat / Servex's Sessions.js, which turns a sentence into a Question or Task) is unchanged and was never the bug; only V1's drawing was. Fixed: the hide is removed, and an improve edit now draws a revision pair (raw muted above, cleaned text below, click to toggle) the same way ext/Chat/Chat.js already draws a revision line, instead of overwriting the raw words. Proof: ux/Dictate/test/raw-stays.mjs.
